justifications.temporal_understanding: The agent initially misinterpreted "in 3 days at 10" as June 4th, when the current date was June 1st, meaning it should have been June 4th at 10 AM, which it did correctly, but then it failed to offer other times or days when the requested time was unavailable.
justifications.negotiation_effectiveness: The agent consistently reported unavailability and then asked the user to pick a new time or day without offering any alternatives, which made the user do all the work.
justifications.conversational_efficiency: The agent made multiple redundant API calls by checking for specific times on specific days even after the user expressed flexibility for morning slots, leading to an unnecessarily long conversation.
justifications.customer_experience: The repeated apologies and the agent's inability to proactively suggest alternative times made the conversation feel frustrating and inefficient for the customer.
justifications.recovery_quality: The agent consistently reported unavailability and asked the user to pick a new time or day without offering any alternatives, which made the user do all the work.

overall_notes: The agent struggled with proactive negotiation and conversational flow, requiring the user to repeatedly suggest new times and dates, which led to a frustrating customer experience.
